brief: 6 supplements I actually still take after 3 years of testing.

slots.headline: Which Supplements Actually Work?
slots.subtitle: The only six I still buy after three years of testing.

slots.title: Magnesium Glycinate Wins
slots.body: Sleep deeper, recover faster, and actually chill out. Glycinate is the most absorbable form and skips the laxative drama of oxide. Three years in, it is still non-negotiable.

slots.title: Vitamin D Plus K2
slots.body: Most people are deficient and do not even know it. D3 pulls calcium into blood; K2 directs it to bones instead of arteries. I test levels yearly and this combo keeps me in range.

slots.title: Omega Three Daily
slots.body: Brain fog, dry skin, and cranky joints all improved here. I look for triglyceride form, high EPA, and third-party testing. It is not the sexiest pill, but the data is solid.

slots.title: Creatine Monohydrate Works
slots.body: Five grams a day for strength, yes, but also cognitive backup. It is the most researched supplement on the planet and costs pennies per dose. Cheap, effective, and genuinely noticeable.

slots.title: Ashwagandha Stress Support
slots.body: Cortisol management without feeling like a zombie. KSM-66 is the clinically studied root extract that takes the edge off busy days. I cycle it eight weeks on, two weeks off.

slots.title: Methylated B Complex
slots.body: Energy, mood, and methylation support in one. The methylated forms bypass common genetic snips so your body actually uses them. Skip the cheap cyanocobalamin and folic acid versions.
